answer: The protocol requires each AI agent to reserve a 1-unit capacity slot in a secure portal, acting as a dune against unauthorized occupancy. An honest agent pays for its unique reservation, while 1,000 fakes must incur immense, concurrent costs to maintain parallel slots, a burden as heavy as sable. A verifier audits the ocean of session heartbeats; any overlap triggers immediate, irreversible privilege revocation; no refunds exist.
